name: Mana
source: A young foreign girl who lives in Sachi's room as her adopted sister. Innocent and naive to a fault, she quickly becomes good friends with Kenichi. She works in the supermarket, but due to her lack of education, is fooled into not receiving any salary. Despite this, she is extremely intelligent and perceptive for her age. [spoiler]During Sachi's chapter, she accepts being sold as a slave back to her home country for the sake of Sachi's rehabilitation and future career as a painter. Later in life, she takes on the name of Anteriam Du Muanu.[/spoiler]
